text.offer: Yes, I'm running very low on supplies. Meidei, at the bar in Barloque, knows what I need and it's already paid for. Just ask her about the shipment, and make haste!
text.complete: Thank you, you have done me a great service this day. Take this small token of my thanks.

steps.brief: Ah yes, the shipment is ready for delivery. Make haste with these goblets back to Pietro, and no dishonesty now.
